note: The memory set of the live agent eval (agent design 5.2): 10 prompts over the 30 memories of MemoryRecallEvalTests.memories (want and forbid are indexes into that list). recall: the request must hold the wanted memories. trap: the prompt shares a word with a memory but is not about it, so the request must not hold the forbidden memory (BM25 has no score floor, so these measure wrong recalls). save: an explicit 'remember that' that RememberLogic must keep as saved (text compared ignoring case, accents and end punctuation), and thenAsk must recall it afterwards. Run by AgentMemoryEvalSmokeTests and AgentMemoryEvalSupportTests.
